unit.why: A single anecdote: on a Friday ride to the river R. Baruch of Medzhybizh tests whether the Seer of Lublin can perceive his yihudim.

stories.start_quote: כאשר הי' מרן מלובלין פ"א אצל
stories.summary_en: While the Seer of Lublin visits R. Baruch of Medzhybizh, the two ride on Sabbath eve to immerse in the river; R. Baruch performs awesome yihudim and repeatedly asks the Seer what he senses, and the Seer answers in stages: the air of the Land of Israel, Jerusalem, the Temple site, and at the immersion the pure rivers of balsam, which leads R. Baruch to praise him as a true seer.

quotes: ביחוד שמו הקדוש ביחודים נוראים ונפלאים
